Hey /v/engineering!

I graduated with a B.S. in Chemical Engineering in 2013 and have been interested in green technology for a very long time. What industries in this sector are actively hiring engineers? The no-brainer is biofuels, but my impression is that electric is more likely to win out the renewable transportation war. Does anything else come to mind?
